changes.why: v0.8.0 renamed maxWith to maxBy with the same code (createMaxMinWith(gt) became _createMaxMinBy(gt)); R.maxWith is gone
v0.8.0 renamed minWith to minBy with the same code; R.minWith is gone
v0.8.0 renamed pickWith to pickBy with the same results (the private pickWith became _pickBy); R.pickWith is gone
v0.8.0 removed R.xprodWith (commit 'remove R.xprodWith')

v0.8.0 renamed the old props (flip(prop)) to propOf and reused the name for 'multiple get': props(ps, obj) is [obj[ps[0]], ...], so the signature changed from (obj, p): Option<V> to (ps: seq<string>, obj): seq<Option<V>> (node: props({x: 100}, 'x') went from 100 to [undefined])

v0.8.0 renamed cond(condition, onTrue, onFalse) to ifElse and reused cond for [predicate, transformer] pairs, returning the first matching transformer's result or undefined: the signature changed to cond(pairs: seq<(A -> bool, A -> B)>): A -> Option<B>
v0.8.0's _slice allocates Math.max(0, to - from), so take(-1, l) went from RangeError to []: n: nat widens to n: int, every previous result unchanged

v0.8.0's _slice copies nothing for a negative length, so a negative start cuts at 0 (remove(-1, 2, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) went from RangeError to [2, 3, 4, 5]): requires 0 <= start is dropped, requires 0 <= start + count stays, every previous result unchanged
knock-on of the xprodWith removal: the revealed body called xprodWith and is rewritten as its own recursion (Ramda's xprod has its own loops), same results
encodes the result of R.lens (new in v0.8.0), a function carrying set and map properties, as a record of get, set_ and map_ (set and map are Dafny keywords)
v0.8.0 defines R.nth in ramda.js's Core Functions section (v0.4.1 had removed List.nth, an alias of prop): list[n], or list[list.length + n] for a negative n, undefined (None) out of range
new in v0.8.0: R.prependTo = flip(_prepend)
new in v0.8.0: R.appendTo = flip(_append)
new in v0.8.0 (defined among the internal functions; v0.2.0 had removed the JSON-based one): a deep copy that keeps functions by reference; a Dafny value is its own copy
new in v0.8.0: R.commuteMap(fn, of, list) = reduce((acc, ftor) => ap(map(append, fn(ftor)), acc), of([]), list), ported for arrays
new in v0.8.0: R.commute = commuteMap(map(identity))
new in v0.8.0 (defined in ramda.js's List Functions section): R.lens(get, set) returns get as a function with the properties set and map(fn, a) = set(fn(get(a)), a)
new name in v0.8.0 for the old props, same code: flip(prop)
new name in v0.8.0 for pickWith, same results: the properties for which test(val, key, obj) is truthy
new in v0.8.0: R.assoc(prop, val, obj), a shallow copy of obj with prop set to val
new name in v0.8.0 for v0.6.0's cond, same code: condition(...) ? onTrue(...) : onFalse(...)
new in v0.8.0: the alias R['if'] = ifElse (if is a Dafny keyword)
new name in v0.8.0 for maxWith, same code: the first element with the greatest key, undefined for []
new name in v0.8.0 for minWith, same code: the first element with the least key, undefined for []
